quote: Our goal is to produce human-preferred summaries by exploiting LLM feedback with respect to the three core dimensions, namely faithfulness, ensuring summaries are consistent with original documents; completeness, encompassing all key-facts; and conciseness, maintaining a succinct and focused summary.
